shabad.source_english: Codes of Conduct and Other Panthic Sources

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਹੁਤ ਬਾੰਤ ਕਾ ਖਾਲਸਾ ਕਹਿੰ ਲਗ ਕਰਉ ਬਖਾਨ॥
verses.translit_en: bahut baa(n)t kaa khaalasaa kahi(n) lag karau bakhaan||

en.bdb: There are many types of Khalsas, how may I even begin to describe them?

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਹਤਵਾਨ ਸੁਭ ਸਿੰਘ ਜੋ ਤਿਨ ਸੋ ਲੇਇ ਪਛਾਨ॥੮੩॥
verses.translit_en: rahatavaan subh si(n)gh jo tin so lei pachhaan||83||

en.bdb: However, one can recognize them by their adherence to the Rehit.
